title: Context API and Component Reusability
description: Learn how to manage global state with React's Context API and build reusable components for cleaner, maintainable code.

lessons.title: What is Context API?
lessons.content: Context API allows you to share state globally across the component tree without passing props manually at every level.

lessons.title: Creating a Context
Providing Context to Components
Consuming Context with useContext Hook
When to Use Context API
lessons.content: Use Context API for themes, user authentication, language settings, or any global data that many components need.

lessons.title: What is Component Reusability?
lessons.content: Component reusability means creating flexible, independent components that can be used in multiple places without rewriting code.

lessons.title: Building Reusable Button Component
Reusable Input Component with Props
Composition for Reusable Components
lessons.content: Component composition lets you build complex components by combining smaller reusable ones, enhancing modularity.

lessons.title: Using Context and Reusable Components Together
